build_inpainting_pipeline: build a StableDiffusionXLControlNetUnionInpaintPipeline to inpaint images using ControlNet Union with text prompts
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP text embeddings for the Stable Diffusion XL model
prepare_control_images: prepare and preprocess control images for ControlNet conditioning with proper batching and device placement
generate_inpainted_images: generate inpainted images by calling the pipeline with prompt, mask_image, and control_image parameters
prepare_latents_for_inpainting: prepare initial latents for inpainting by encoding images through VAE and adding noise based on strength
